title: Four wheeled Wheelchairs
description: A resource pack that adds front wheels to the wheelchairs from the Wheelchairs mod.
body:
A simple resource pack that adds front wheels to the wheelchairs from the Wheelchairs mod. They're not animated or anything, and can't be customized like the main wheels, but they're there.
You will need [The Wheelchairs mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/wheelchairs) to use this.
![A picture of a wooden wheelchair with a black cushion. It has two large wheels and two small wheels.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8512d57584d7da72c24493a000064ea96708e780.png)
